# Updating a note is refused for this key, before the note is looked up

**Claim.** Every request from the research key is refused with 403 FORBIDDEN whether or not the note exists, so the success path documented for this operation comes from the official docs alone.

Applies to: `~1people~1{vanId}~1notes~1{noteId}/put`

## Observed exchange

_A real person with a real note, so the 403 cannot be blamed on a missing target._

```http
(setup) POST /people/create

{
  "firstName": "Ezra",
  "lastName": "Thistlewood-{scope}"
}

→ 201
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000001
{
  "vanId": 100000001,
  "status": "Stored"
}
```
```http
(setup) POST /people/100000001/notes

{
  "text": "Original text.",
  "isViewRestricted": false
}

→ 204
```
```http
(setup) GET /people/100000001/notes

→ 200
{
  "items": [
    {
      "contactHistory": null,
      "noteId": 100000002,
      "text": "Original text.",
      "isViewRestricted": false,
      "category": {
        "noteCategoryId": 0,
        "name": null
      },
      "createdDate": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "isPinned": false
    }
  ],
  "nextPageLink": null,
  "count": 1
}
```
```http
PUT /people/100000001/notes/100000002

{
  "text": "Updated text."
}

→ 403
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "FORBIDDEN",
      "text": "Access to this action is restricted"
    }
  ]
}
```

_A noteId that cannot exist is refused identically — the check runs first._

```http
PUT /people/100000001/notes/2147483646

{
  "text": "Updated text."
}

→ 403
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "FORBIDDEN",
      "text": "Access to this action is restricted"
    }
  ]
}
```
